items_selling_price_within_mrp.name: items_selling_price_within_mrp
items_selling_price_within_mrp.value: "items"."selling_price_paise" IS NULL OR "items"."mrp_paise" IS NULL OR "items"."selling_price_paise" <= "items"."mrp_paise"

stock_movements_shape.name: stock_movements_shape

stock_movements_reason.name: stock_movements_reason
stock_movements_reason.value:
("stock_movements"."type"::text = 'ADJUST') = ("stock_movements"."reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("stock_movements"."reason"::text <> 'OTHER' OR nullif(btrim("stock_movements"."note"), '') IS NOT NULL)

orders_completed_fields.name: orders_completed_fields
orders_completed_fields.value:
"orders"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR (
        "orders"."order_number" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."vendor_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "orders"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND "orders"."subtotal_paise" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."discount_paise" IS NOT NULL
        AND "orders"."total_paise" IS NOT NULL
      )

orders_cancelled_fields.name: orders_cancelled_fields
orders_cancelled_fields.value:
("orders"."status"::text = 'CANCELLED') = (
        "orders"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND nullif(btrim("orders"."cancel_reason"), '') IS NOT NULL
      )
